name: BAT OVHT
description: Battery overtemperature, above 70°C. Voice message "BATTERY OVERHEAT".

procedure.heading: On ground:
procedure.text:
1. BAT MSTR sw — OFF (BAT DISCONN will appear)
2. Engines — Shut down

procedure.heading: In flight:
procedure.text:
1. BAT MSTR sw — OFF (BAT DISCONN will appear)
2. LAND AS SOON AS POSSIBLE
After landing:
3. Engines — Leave running in IDLE
If EPU is available:
4. EPU — Connect
5. BAT MSTR sw — ON
6. Engine shutdown — Perform
If EPU is not available:
4. Engine shutdown — Perform
Battery must be inspected or replaced prior to next flight.

references: FLM EC135 T3H Sect. 3.7.1 (Helionix Step 3.5, 3 MFD)
